mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the Federal Funds Rate above 2.5% triggers a tightening cycle, increasing risk premiums and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.5 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 2.5, or the rate does not cross above 2.5 as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not decline sufficiently or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a labor market tightness, leading to higher inflation expectations and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.5% or returns remain positive despite the drop.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates growing economic activity, lowering risk-free rates and enhancing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not increase sufficiently or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in both quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly industrial production (RSAFS) signal robust demand, reducing interest rate expectations and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or RSAFS does not increase, or returns remain non-positive despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle, a sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate lowers discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The easing cycle ends prematurely or FEDFUNDS do not decline sufficiently, resulting in non-positive 60-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers heightened inflation expectations, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.5% or returns remain positive within the 5-day window despite the drop.
